newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Recticel jumps after buy advice.
newsitem.headline: Recticel jumps after buy advice.

text.p: Belgian polyurethane foam producer Recticel SA soared nine percent on the Brussels bourse on Tuesday on stockpicking following a buy advice by a leading investment letter.
The De Belegger weekly investment letter, which already gave a buy advice for Recticel's ordinary shares in March, said on Tuesday it now preferred its preferred stock.
Dealers said that Recticel had been lagging the market.
"Most other shares are topping out so people are turning to stocks with potential," one said.
At 1150 GMT, Recticel was up 9.0 percent at 458 francs, preferred stock was up 8.5 percent at 534.
